tips_en: Read Sage S2.1 Flash first: it is the most ambitious systems paper here, integrating heterogeneous scientific data with verifiable long-horizon tool use and showing strong results across 33 benchmarks. Its outcome-based reinforcement learning and workflow evaluation provide a useful contrast to InclusionMed’s role- and capability-focused healthcare benchmarking and AllocFlow’s end-to-end, after-fee portfolio learning; together, the papers examine how to evaluate and optimize models whose outputs must operate reliably in real workflows.
tips_zh: 建议先读 Sage S2.1 Flash：它最具系统性与技术深度，将异构科学数据、可验证的长程工具调用及强化学习后训练整合起来，并在 33 个基准上展示强结果。它与 InclusionMed 的角色/能力导向医疗评测，以及 AllocFlow 的端到端扣费后组合学习形成有趣对照；三篇论文共同关注如何在真实工作流中可靠地评估并优化模型输出。
